_doc: Every source file that imports react-native-gesture-handler, react-native-reanimated or @shopify/react-native-skia, with what differs between the browser render and a phone and what stays residual (device-lab spec U2-U4). A new importer fails lib/device-lab/__tests__/nativeUiResiduals.test.ts until it is listed. The worklet lint rule (mobile-learn/js-function-in-worklet) guards the part a browser cannot show.

frontend/mla-tamagui/components/charts-s.differs: victory-native draws on CanvasKit on web and native Skia on a phone
frontend/mla-tamagui/components/charts-s.residual: spike route, web only: native charts are not claimed

frontend/mla-tamagui/app/_layout.tsx.differs: GestureHandlerRootView is the root of every gesture; web runs pointer events
frontend/mla-tamagui/app/_layout.tsx.residual: root wrapper; every screen below inherits the residuals of its own gestures

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/u.differs: shared values animate on the UI thread on a phone, in a JS loop on web
frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/u.residual: visual only; the recording level it draws comes from the recorder

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/u.differs: drag to reorder: arbitration with the scroll view differs, no UI-thread worklets on web
frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/u.residual: drag-reorder feel and scroll arbitration are device-only

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/u.differs: drag to reorder: arbitration with the scroll view differs, no UI-thread worklets on web
frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/u.residual: drag-reorder feel and scroll arbitration are device-only

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/tamil-writ.differs: CanvasKit on web, native Skia rasterisation on a phone; pan on JS thread (runOnJS)
frontend/mla-tamagui/features/tamil-writ.residual: stroke smoothing and antialiasing on Skia differ in pixels; the marking reads points, not pixels

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/tamil-writ.differs: pan on the JS thread (runOnJS); touch slop and multi-touch rejection differ
frontend/mla-tamagui/features/tamil-writ.residual: palm and second-finger rejection are device-only

frontend/mla-tamagui/app-shell/DebugFab..differs: drag and tap race; the FAB position is a UI-thread shared value on a phone

frontend/libraries/tamagui-design-system.differs: scroll-linked values: JS events on web, UI-thread worklets on a phone
frontend/libraries/tamagui-design-system.residual: scroll-linked collapse is smoother on a device; web follows each scroll event

frontend/libraries/tamagui-design-system.differs: only reads the library for its config
